no-categories: No categories yet. Add one or start with defaults.
workspace-logo-description: Pick an image resource, paste a URL, or generate a mark with the configured image model.
logo-url-description: An http(s) image URL or a generated inline image.
logo-generated-inline: Generated inline image (stored with the workspace)
logo-prompt-description: e.g. a minimal teal compass inside a rounded square
agent-directories-description: Choose where the agent works and which folders skills are loaded from.
working-directories-description: Directories the agent is allowed to run in. One can be the default.
skills-directories-description: Skills are loaded from these folders in the order below.
directory-path-description: Absolute path, or a path starting with ~ .
directory-label-description: Optional. Defaults to the folder name.
share-approvals-description: Review who can access a shared note. Internal recipients and email invitees approve before access is granted, and administrators can gate every share.
require-share-approval-description: When on, new internal, email and public shares stay pending until an administrator approves them.
no-share-requests: No share requests are waiting for you.
no-outgoing-share-requests: You have not requested any shares yet.
invite-by-email-description: Send an approval link to someone who is not in your team list.
invite-sent: Invitation sent. It stays pending until the recipient approves.
invite-created-copy-link: Invitation created. Email delivery is not configured, so share this link instead — it stays pending until approved.
share-message-description: Optional note shown with the share request.
share-request-sent: Share request sent. It becomes active once the recipient approves.
share-pending-admin-approval: Submitted for administrator approval. The public link activates once it is approved.
custom-form-fields-description: Add your own fields to the ticket and study forms.
form-field-delete-warning: Delete the "{{field}}" field? Stored values stay on existing records but will no longer be shown.
field-key-description: Stable identifier used to store the value.
theme-color-hint: Accent used for buttons, links and highlights.
ui-scale-hint: Scales text and spacing across the app.
density-hint: Compact fits more cards on screen.
shadow-style-hint: Flat removes depth, strong deepens card and panel shadows.
corner-style-hint: Sharp gives precise edges, rounded keeps the softer look.
responsive-layout-hint: Follow the window size automatically, or keep the compact layout on any screen — useful in a narrow desktop window.
side-nav-mode-hint: Pin the sidebar on wide windows, or keep it in a drawer and reclaim the space.
touch-targets-hint: Large targets suit touch screens; standard targets fit more rows on a mouse-driven display.
text-fold-length-hint: Characters shown before a card is folded.
hidden-mobile-bar-hint: The bar comes back when you scroll up.
default-home-page-hint: Where the app opens. Leave empty for the notes board.
reduce-motion-hint: Follows your system setting by default.
contrast-boost-hint: Stronger borders and darker secondary text.
webhook-endpoint-hint: HTTPS URL called when a note changes.
system-tray: Keep running in the system tray
invalid-setting-value: That value is not valid for this setting.
question: Question
no-skills-yet: No skills yet — add one to track mastery.
insights-description: Analytics and reports for your notes, plans, and learning.
reports-modal-description: A monthly summary across notes, tags, tickets, and study.
analytics-modal-description: Heatmaps, totals, and tag distribution for a selected month.
archive-resources-description: Archived notes and agent-selected knowledge, alongside files.
agent-notes-description: Agenda notes selected for the agent.
done-status-hint: დასრულებულია ბარათის სტატუსია (მონიშნე დასრულებულად), არა კატეგორია. კატეგორიებია სალილები როგორიცაა Now, Next და Later.
